reels.hook: VAJRA PP shuttering sheet ko site pe normal cutter se aaram se kaat sakte hain, bilkul ply ki tarah.
Beam shuttering ke liye VAJRA PP shuttering sheet se bana mould use karein.
VAJRA PP shuttering sheet se de-shuttering hui aasan aur concrete finish mila ekdum smooth!
Baarish aur paani se ply phool kar kharab ho jati hai aur nuksan hota hai.
Slab, beam aur column dhalai ke liye best hai VAJRA PP shuttering sheet.
Bhari ply uthane se pareshan hain? Dekhiye iska asaan solution PP shuttering sheet ke saath.
Har baar naya ply khareedne se pareshan hain? Dekhiye RCC slab aur column ka naya solution.

images.hook: Slab, beam, column: sab VAJRA PP shuttering sheet se. Swipe karke dekho 👉
Itna moda, phir bhi toota nahi. Lachila PP.
Site pe lagao, kaam shuru. Column aur slab dono.
Sariya cage taiyaar, phir PP panel se column band.
